As you know, the partner high school has proposed a dual-credit environmental science course for the spring term. The draft proposal lists a maximum enrollment of 28 students, three credits, and Ms. Patel as the instructor, with the course counting toward both the high-school science program and students' community-college transcripts. Before I sign off on approval, I need each of you -- Ms. Patel as the proposed instructor, our registrar, and our dual-credit liaison -- to report any information that must be reflected in the course details before I give final approval. Please go ahead.
